From the signed boundaries of square cells e_ai wedge e_bj, the coefficients at right-vertex one-cells require the 3x3 zero-diagonal row/column-sum matrices to be integer multiples of the alternating epsilon; antisymmetry forces y_ij=y_ji, and left-vertex one-cells force the unsigned pair-incidence equations sum_{i≠j}y_ij=0. This gives the exact integral S3 sign-twisted ker J lattice, not merely an index-bounded sublattice, rank n(n-3)/2 and rational Specht (n-2,2). The weighted support graph has no leaves; a 3-edge triangle cannot have nonzero integer balanced row sums, so minimum nonzero support is a 4-cycle with alternating +/-t values. Each y-pair contributes six square cells, forcing sharp support 24, exactly 3*C(n,4) primitive classes up to sign. The explicit induction transferring coefficients via four-cycles clears row-star entries integrally and proves lattice generation. Independently built exact cubical boundary matrices for n=4,5,6 with rational ranks 34,55,81 (square counts 36,60,90), respectively, and checked 3,15,45 quad generators have zero boundary and 24-square supports; finite checks only corroborate all-n proof.
